# tegridydev

> Open source developer and independent researcher building local tools, open datasets and practical research projects around security, language models and interesting problems.

tegridydev works across AI security, local LLMs, dataset engineering, mechanistic interpretability, multi agent systems, OSINT and physical security systems. Most projects begin as a question or a useful personal tool and are published when they may help other people.

## Profiles

- [GitHub](https://github.com/tegridydev): Open source projects and code.
- [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/tegridydev): Datasets, models, articles and research activity.

## Selected work

- [auto-md](https://github.com/tegridydev/auto-md): Turn files, folders and GitHub repositories into clean Markdown for LLM and RAG workflows.
- [abstract-agent](https://github.com/tegridydev/abstract-agent): Local multi agent research workflow for exploring literature, novelty and hypotheses.
- [Mechanistic Interpretability](https://github.com/tegridydev/Mechanistic-Interpretability): Research notes and open tools for inspecting transformer internals.
- [MechaMap](https://github.com/tegridydev/mechamap): A related mechanistic interpretability project.
- [multi-agent-secops-llm](https://github.com/tegridydev/multi-agent-secops-llm): Experiments with LLM agents for security operations and analysis.
- [physical-security-dev](https://github.com/tegridydev/physical-security-dev): Practical notes for CCTV, access control and physical security development.
- [Python OSINT Notebook](https://github.com/tegridydev/python-OSINT-notebook): OSINT tooling, Python automation and intelligence workflows.
- [dnd-llm-game](https://github.com/tegridydev/dnd-llm-game): Local multi LLM role playing and interactive storytelling.

## Research and data

- [Research Papers](https://huggingface.co/datasets/tegridydev/research-papers): Academic documents for OCR, classification and multimodal research. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/8911).
- [Open-MalSec](https://huggingface.co/datasets/tegridydev/open-malsec): Open cybersecurity data covering phishing, malware, vulnerabilities, fraud and hostile communications. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/5104).
- [Infosec Tool Output](https://huggingface.co/datasets/tegridydev/infosec-tool-output): Structured security tool output for blue team and security agent research. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/7654).

## Writing

- [Research Papers Dataset](https://huggingface.co/blog/tegridydev/research-papers-dataset): How and why I built the research papers dataset.
- [LLM Dataset Formats 101](https://huggingface.co/blog/tegridydev/llm-dataset-formats-101-hugging-face): A plain guide to common dataset formats.
- [WTF is Fine-Tuning?](https://huggingface.co/blog/tegridydev/fine-tuning-dev-intro-2025): A plain English intro to fine tuning.

## Research citations

- [Toward Equitable Arabic Cybersecurity Literacy](https://doi.org/10.3390/mca31050168): Peer reviewed research that used Open MalSec as an experimental cybersecurity corpus.
- [WaveformQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20638): Research preprint that cites LLM Dataset Formats 101.
